topic: AutoMat re-evaluation can expose prior evaluator outputs through the same artifact directory

sources.fact: _list_artifact_files recursively lists every file in the selected artifact directory and applies no producer/filename exclusion.

facts: The evaluator receives that full listing as 'Files Produced by the Agent' orientation and can Read/Grep/Glob the artifact directory with read-only tools.
The system prompt tells it to investigate produced artifacts and analysis reports before scoring.
After an evaluation, AutoMat writes repro_eval_prompt.txt and repro_evaluation_results.json into the same artifact directory being evaluated.

Manual --evaluate mode later reuses that artifact directory and calls the evaluator before overwriting those same output files, so the prior evaluator files already exist during the new input listing/inspection phase.

derived_scope_limited_findings.claim: AutoMat's first evaluation does not create prior-judge contamination because evaluator outputs are written only after that evaluation. But a later re-evaluation of the same artifact directory can expose the previous repro_evaluation_results.json and repro_eval_prompt.txt to the new evaluator because all files are listed and the evaluator has read access to the directory. Therefore evaluator-output provenance must be namespace-separated or explicitly excluded from scoring inputs before independent re-evaluation.
derived_scope_limited_findings.scope: Static re-evaluation data-flow finding. It does not establish that a re-evaluator actually opened or was influenced by the prior verdict in any published run.

protocol_implication.name: REVIEWER_OUTPUT_NONREENTRY_GATE
protocol_implication.rule: Freeze the reviewer input snapshot before emitting any evaluator output. Classify files by producer. Primary/independent scoring inputs may include agent artifacts, harness traces and reference materials, but must exclude prior/current evaluator prompts, verdicts and rationales. Save evaluator outputs to a separate content-addressed verdict namespace. Re-evaluation creates a new verdict over the same or a newly frozen input manifest without making prior verdict bytes visible to the scoring model unless an explicitly labeled meta-comparison mode is requested.
protocol_implication.relation: Complements p1-protocol-057 REVIEWER_INPUT_SNAPSHOT_AND_ARCHIVE_COHERENCE_GATE by preventing evaluator-generated bytes from entering the next reviewer input snapshot.

causal_boundary: No published score bias is alleged; this is a potential independence/reproducibility failure class in the exact public re-evaluation path.
